blocks.text: VIGAN CITY, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Residents in this province availed themselves of free government services and assistance programs at the CHAVIT Coliseum here on Monday, Sept. 14, as part of activities marking President Marcos’s birthday. Dubbed “Handog ng Pangulo: Serbisyong Sapat Para sa Lahat,” the annual initiative brought together national government agencies and provincial offices to provide residents with government services, financial assistance, and livelihood support. The event was held a day after Marcos’ birthday on Sept. 13.
